notes.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is Out Now! ⚔️
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/f92a4d80d0acad119963abf1a4d58e667ddacae0.jpg[/img]

Greetings friends!!!
We have some great news to share with you today.

[b]Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is now available on Steam! We are offering a special 15% discount during the launch period[/b]
The game is also available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/

At its core this is a Souls-like game that features Metroidvania elements, filled with exploration and secrets to be found.

You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey.

[h3]Let's celebrate the game's launch![/h3]
In honor of the release, please watch the trailer and immerse yourself in the world of Makh-Abyss before fully exploring the story and finding out what actually happened after the death of Lord Derek Ericona.

[previewyoutube=PtAhNjGXCuY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Terminal Squad: Swarmites coming soon
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34020822/b94cf8ae884c9c4f82587acccc625b647086d69c.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!
Trinity Project publisher is gonna release new Terminal Squad game on January 30. The second part of the series is a real-time strategy with indirect control of the fight. To win, you must build a base, undertake research and also use some various tricks. The right strategy for developing your base is the key to victory. Please, add Terminal Squad games to your wishlist and subscribe to them. Don't miss the news, release and discounts!
